svg.title: doc-kit's worker pool, a slab with a lane for each of its four threads, and around it a tile for each generator this site's build runs, joined by rails from each generator to the ones that read its result. Each sends its work to the pool in chunks, collects every chunk back, and only then hands its whole result on. The outputs that read the same entries run side by side, and each result is freed once its last reader is done, which the memory trace below shows dipping.
svg.text: each result freed after its last reader
